description: This file is a test source file for the NetworkManager plugin, specifically testing the libnm proxy implementation. It contains unit tests for various NetworkManager interface methods such as getting and setting interface states, retrieving IP settings, and configuring IP addresses, using Google Test framework. The tests mock interactions with libnm and related GObject-based APIs to verify correct behavior of the plugin code.

classes.name: NetworkManagerTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing the NetworkManager plugin's libnm proxy implementation. It initializes mocks, sets up environment, and contains various unit tests for NetworkManager functionalities.
